title: Stick Doors and Island
description:
Stranded on a deserted island... or trapped in a locked room – what escape route will you choose?
In this escape game, you're given multiple options to break free – but not all of them will lead to success. Some are clever, some are risky, and others... might just lead to failure.

Find all the successful ways to escape – whether you're solving puzzles in a room or surviving on an island.
Test your logic, think outside the box, and uncover the one true path to freedom.

Will you make it out? Good luck – your escape begins now.

title: Animal Hospital
description:
There's a queue of patients outside the reception window — but after midnight, it isn't only sick animals that come to town.

Some of them are only pretending to be a cat, a dog, or a rabbit: an extra eye, the wrong coat color, a smile that's a little too human, a shadow that shouldn't be there, a voice that's subtly wrong.

Your job is to tell a real patient from an anomaly using nothing but a photo and their paperwork. Let your own kind in and heal them; keep the others off the threshold. Every animal you admit has to be led to a ward and treated through mini-games — and in between, you'll need to run the generator, check the cages, and keep an eye on the security cameras. All of it without losing your mind, and without looking where you shouldn't.

Every shift gets darker, the anomalies grow more numerous, and something that was only pretending to be a patient begins to roam the clinic's corridors. Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Will you live to see the dawn?

title: Same Room Same Day
description: Experience the thrilling psychological horror of "Same Room Same Day." As Rosaline, explore a terrifying building filled with monstrous beings. Face intense challenges, collect crucial supplies, and confront your deepest fears to uncover secrets and seek tranquility in a frightening digital landscape.

title: Room 45
description:
You're trapped in Room 45—and it's watching you.
There are no instructions, no tutorials. Just you, a locked door, and a growing sense that something isn’t right. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and piece together what happened here… before time runs out.

Every object might be a clue. Every second counts.
Can you escape Room 45? Or will it remember you?
